description: Prove anything the superroot commits, by kind: "tx" { chain_id, tx_hash } a transaction; "log" { chain_id, tx_hash, log_index } one event log with calldata for the on-chain verifier; "order" { protocol, key } an order’s whole lifecycle (key like erc8183:8453:81401); "transition" { protocol, seqs } given transitions of a protocol set, in order; "blocks" { chain_id, blocks } up to 256 blocks of a chain; "protocols" {} every protocol set inside the root. GETs /v1/proof/* and /v1/protocols/proven.
name: taifoon_prove
